The '''21st Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2010 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2009, were held at [[Hollywood Palladium]] in [[Hollywood, California]] on January 24, 2010.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Finke|first1=Nikki|title=2010 Producers Guild Awards 'Hurt Locker'|url=https://deadline.com/2010/01/producers-guild-awards-hurt-locker-23428/|website=Deadline|accessdate=February 9, 2018|date=January 24, 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Kilday |first1=Gregg |title='Hurt Locker' wins big at PGA Awards |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/hurt-locker-wins-big-pga-19881 |accessdate=March 31, 2020 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=January 24, 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=McNary |first1=Dave |last2=Siegel |first2=Tatiana |title=Producers vote ‘Locker’ best film |url=https://variety.com/2010/film/awards/producers-vote-locker-best-film-1118014221/ |accessdate=March 31, 2020 |work=Variety |date=January 24, 2010}}</ref> The nominations were announced on November
